title: Buildkite Pipelines
description: Builds, steps, queues and agents for the flunge Buildkite organisation. Build and step figures come from a collector on headcrash that reads the Buildkite API once a minute (Prometheus job buildkite); queue and agent figures come from Buildkite's buildkite-agent-metrics (job buildkite-agents). Totals start when the collector was installed.

panels.title: Builds running
panels.description: Builds that have started and not finished, across every pipeline.

panels.title: Jobs waiting for an agent
panels.description: Jobs that are ready to run and have no agent yet, from Buildkite's own collector.

panels.title: Longest wait now
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting job has been ready to run. Read from the builds API once a minute.

panels.title: Agents busy, by queue
panels.description: Agents running a job now, for each queue that has agents.

panels.title: Agents connected, by queue
panels.description: Agents registered with Buildkite, for each queue that has any.

panels.title: Pipelines failing on main
panels.description: Pipelines whose latest finished build on the default branch failed.

panels.title: Latest result on main, by pipeline
panels.description: The result of each pipeline's most recent passed or failed build on its default branch, and when it finished. A pipeline appears once it has had a build since the collector was installed or in the day before.

panels.title: Recent builds
panels.description: The last 40 builds to finish, newest first. Failed steps lists the steps that failed and were not retried. The build number links to the build in Buildkite.

panels.title: Builds (selected pipelines, over the dashboard's time range)
Builds finished
panels.description: Builds that finished in the time range, whatever the result.

panels.title: Pass rate
panels.description: Passed builds as a share of passed and failed builds. Canceled and skipped builds are left out.

panels.title: Failed builds
panels.description: Builds that finished as failed in the time range.

panels.title: Build time, median
panels.description: Half of the passed builds ran for less than this, from first job starting to build finishing. Read from a histogram, so it is an estimate between two bucket edges.

panels.title: Build time, 90th percentile
panels.description: Nine in ten passed builds ran for less than this. Estimated from a histogram.

panels.title: Wait to start, 90th percentile
panels.description: Nine in ten builds started within this long of being created.

panels.title: Builds finished, by result
panels.description: Each bar is the builds that finished in that interval, split by result.

panels.title: Builds finished, by pipeline
panels.description: Each bar is the builds that finished in that interval, split by pipeline.

panels.title: Build time, median, by pipeline (trailing hour)
panels.description: Median run time of passed builds over the hour before each point. Gaps mean no build passed in that hour.

panels.title: Build time, 90th percentile, by pipeline (trailing hour)
panels.description: 90th-percentile run time of passed builds over the hour before each point.

panels.title: Pass rate, by pipeline (trailing 3 hours)
panels.description: Passed builds as a share of passed and failed builds over the three hours before each point.

panels.title: Builds, by kind of branch
panels.description: main is the pipeline's default branch; merge-queue is GitHub's merge queue; pr is a pull-request branch.

panels.title: Builds, by what started them
panels.description: schedule is a Buildkite schedule, webhook is a push or pull request, ui and api are manual, trigger_job is another pipeline.

panels.title: Steps (selected pipelines, over the dashboard's time range)
Slowest steps, 90th-percentile run time
panels.description: The 15 steps whose passed runs took longest. Estimated from a histogram.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, pipeline, step) (increase(buildkite_job_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline",state="passed"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Failed steps
panels.description: Runs of each step that failed or timed out, including ones that were then retried.

panels.title: Retried steps
panels.description: Runs of each step that were replaced by a retry, automatic or manual.

panels.title: Step run time, median (trailing hour)
panels.description: Median run time of each step's passed runs over the hour before each point. Narrow the Pipeline filter to make this readable.

panels.title: Agent time used, by pipeline
panels.description: Total job run time in each interval, split by pipeline. Jobs running at once add up, so this can exceed the interval.

panels.title: Jobs waiting for an agent, by queue
panels.description: Jobs ready to run with no agent yet. From Buildkite's own collector, every 30 seconds.

panels.title: Agents busy, by queue
panels.description: Agents running a job, for each queue that has agents.

panels.title: Share of agents busy, by queue
panels.description: Busy agents as a share of the queue's connected agents.

panels.title: Wait for an agent, by queue (trailing hour)
panels.description: How long jobs were ready to run before an agent started them, over the hour before each point.

panels.title: Agent hosts (all pipelines, over the dashboard's time range)
Jobs run, by host
panels.description: Jobs each agent host ran to the end, whatever the result.

panels.title: Failed jobs, by host
panels.description: Jobs that failed or timed out on each host. One host standing out suggests a problem with that host rather than the code.

panels.title: Job time, by host
panels.description: Total job run time on each host in each interval.

panels.title: Builds data age
panels.description: Seconds since the build collector last read the Buildkite API. It reads once a minute.

panels.title: Failed API reads (24h)
panels.description: Times the build collector could not read the Buildkite API in the last day.

panels.title: API requests left this minute
panels.description: What is left of Buildkite's 200-requests-a-minute limit for the collector's token after its last read.

panels.title: Collectors up
panels.description: Of the two collectors Prometheus reads (builds, and queues and agents), how many answered.
